name: LRCLIB
author: LRCLIB community
summary: Every word, closer to the music.
description: Bring your songs to life with lyrics from a free, open database built by music lovers. Follow along with synchronized lyrics, or settle into a quiet read when timings aren't available.
privacy: When you open lyrics, Klang sends the song title, artist, album and duration to LRCLIB to find a match. No account or API key is needed.

settings.title: Keep lyrics offline
settings.description: Save lyrics you open for your next listen

settings.title: Timing adjustment
settings.description: Negative values show lyrics earlier; positive values show them later
